'''Tabbot''' was the [[Director/Legends|Director]] of the [[Prototype Construction and Design Support Division]] at the [[Maw Installation]]. Tabbot died in an industrial accident, leading [[Tol Sivron]] to take over the Division.<ref name="The Jedi Academy Sourcebook" />
